convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom indicators (XPeriodCandle) which are non-standard custom indicators requiring manual recreation in Python. Two independent custom indicator instances with crossover logic between them.

other_exits: Opposite signal closes current position before opening new one (reversal logic inherent in no_opposite_side gate)

custom_logic_notes: This is an Exp_ (Expert) variant of the XPeriodCandle indicator system. The 'X2' suffix indicates it uses two instances of the XPeriodCandle custom indicator with different periods for crossover signals. The XPeriodCandle indicator is a custom indicator that creates candle-based representations over variable periods - its internal logic (SmoothType parameter behavior) is not visible from the EA code alone and must be obtained from the indicator source. Signal reversal closes existing opposite positions before entry.
python_conversion_notes: The XPeriodCandle custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python before the EA logic can be converted. The EA itself is structurally simple (dual-indicator crossover with fixed SL/TP), but the dependency on the custom indicator makes this a manual conversion. If the XPeriodCandle source is available, port it first, then the EA logic is straightforward: compute two XPeriodCandle series, detect crossovers, manage positions with fixed SL/TP. The new-bar guard must be replicated to prevent multiple signals per bar.
